title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-17

ai_review.summary: Hissy audience recording of a historic set that delivers an iconic Dark Star and the debut Box of Rain, but low‑fidelity sound limits enjoyment.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its historical significance – it captures the first live rendition of "Box of Rain" and a monumental "Dark Star" – and many listeners rate the playing highly. However, the tape is an audience (AUD) source with noticeable hiss, quiet sections and overall poor fidelity, though the sound improves after the opening minutes. The combination of strong musical moments with sub‑par audio results in a mixed listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers consistently praise the show (high musical rating) but criticize the recording quality (low technical rating); weighting these gives a mid‑range overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as hissy, quiet and low‑fidelity; some improvement after the first few minutes but generally poorer than soundboard standards.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early part suffers from poor audio, but the second half shines with a monumental Dark Star and the debut Box of Rain, giving the show historic weight despite technical flaws.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's vocal performance/lyrics are noted as sounding great.
